bound.statement: For every manifest of at most 65536 bytes that passes the decode, structure and semantic stages, the number of content chunk references is at most 2847. A load therefore makes at most 3 + 2847 = 2850 eth_getCode requests (manifest chunks plus content chunks), and with the session cache at most 3 + (distinct content keys).
bound.minBytesPerReference: 23: a chunk reference is a 2-item list of a 20-byte string (0x94 + 20 bytes = 21) and an integer 1..24575 (at least 1 byte); body >= 22, so >= 23 with its 1-byte list header. Non-canonical or other widths are rejected before this stage.
bound.minFixedOverhead: 54 for any manifest with N >= 2847 references: top-level header 3 (65482 <= body < 65536), version 1, entryIndex 1, files-list header 3, one file: list header 3, path >= 3 ('/a'), mime 1, size >= 3 (size >= N >= 256), contentHash 33, chunks-list header 3. Each further file adds at least 42 bytes and no reference capacity.
bound.scope: This is a viewer bound derived from the RLP size limit. The 0.3 figure of 426 (R3-04) assumed the canonical publisher split (P04) and is withdrawn as a viewer bound: B07 accepts any chunk lengths 1..24575 that sum to the size, and this draft does not restrict valid non-canonical splits.

fixtures.note: Attains the bound. Header bytes: f9fffc (65532-byte list), 01, 80, f9fff7 (files), f9fff4 (file), 82 2f 61 ('/a'), 01 (mime), 82 16 3e (size 5694).
A non-canonical split (100 + 11 instead of 111) is valid under B07; the viewer must accept it.
